title: TypedEffect
description: Closed #4 effect-type set. HUMAN_STATE_DELTA and LOCATION_SET are implemented in Foundation. RELATION_TOUCH (Slice 3B), HOME_TRANSITION (Slice 3C), WARDROBE_TRANSITION (Slice 3D), FINANCE_TRANSACTION (Slice 3E), TASK_PROGRESS (Slice 5B1), and COMMITMENT_COMPLETE (Slice 5B2C2B) have strict payloads but Foundation apply_effect still raises UNSUPPORTED_EFFECT for all except HUMAN_STATE_DELTA/LOCATION_SET. Totally unknown types fail SCHEMA_INVALID.

payload.description: Slice 3B structural payload only (keys/types/additionalProperties). Semantic rules — Asia/Tokyo canonicalize, reject bad/naive/fractional timestamps, and null-or-same-instant for in_person_at — are enforced by normalize_relation_touch_effect, not by this schema alone. No closeness/friendship/trust, names, roles, or prose.

contact_at.description: Structural: non-empty string. Semantic canonicalize to Asia/Tokyo +09:00 is owned by normalize_relation_touch_effect.

in_person_at.description: Structural: string or null. Semantic null-or-same-instant vs contact_at is owned by normalize_relation_touch_effect (schema alone does not enforce equality).

oneOf.description: Strict RELATION_TOUCH (Slice 3B). Structural schema + semantic normalizer; domain reducer only; Foundation apply_effect raises UNSUPPORTED_EFFECT.

payload.description: Slice 3C structural payload only. Semantic Asia/Tokyo canonicalize for transition_at is owned by normalize_home_transition_effect. Coarse status only — no quantity/brand/product/expiry/price/geometry.

transition_at.description: Structural: non-empty string. Semantic canonicalize to Asia/Tokyo +09:00 is owned by normalize_home_transition_effect.
Structural: non-empty string. Semantic canonicalize to Asia/Tokyo +09:00 is owned by normalize_home_transition_effect.

oneOf.description: Strict HOME_TRANSITION (Slice 3C). Structural schema + semantic normalizer; domain reducers only; Foundation apply_effect raises UNSUPPORTED_EFFECT.

payload.description: Slice 3D structural payload only (keys/types/closed enums/additionalProperties). Semantic rules — Asia/Tokyo canonicalize for transition_at and non-null last_worn_at, reject bad/naive/fractional timestamps, and last_worn_at <= transition_at — are enforced by normalize_wardrobe_transition_effect, not by this schema alone. Explicit absolute item-state SET only; no brand/color/style/size/outfit/image/purchase fields, no wear-count increment ops.

transition_at.description: Structural: non-empty string. Semantic canonicalize to Asia/Tokyo +09:00 is owned by normalize_wardrobe_transition_effect.

last_worn_at.description: Structural: string or null. Semantic last_worn_at <= transition_at is owned by normalize_wardrobe_transition_effect.

oneOf.description: Strict WARDROBE_TRANSITION (Slice 3D). Structural schema + semantic normalizer; domain reducer only; Foundation apply_effect raises UNSUPPORTED_EFFECT.

payload.description: Slice 3E structural payload only (keys/types/additionalProperties). Semantic rules — Asia/Tokyo canonicalize for transaction_at, reject bad/naive/fractional timestamps, and true-integer (not bool/string/float) amount_minor / balance_after_minor — are enforced by normalize_finance_transaction_effect, not by this schema alone. Signed integer JPY minor units only; no category/merchant/memo/account/payment/transaction_id.

transaction_at.description: Structural: non-empty string. Semantic canonicalize to Asia/Tokyo +09:00 is owned by normalize_finance_transaction_effect.

amount_minor.description: Signed integer JPY minor units. Positive=inflow, negative=outflow, zero allowed. Bool/float/string rejected by semantic normalizer.

balance_after_minor.description: Explicit post-transaction balance or null (unknown remains unknown). Bool/float/string rejected by semantic normalizer.

oneOf.description: Strict FINANCE_TRANSACTION (Slice 3E). Structural schema + semantic normalizer; domain reducer only; Foundation apply_effect raises UNSUPPORTED_EFFECT.

payload.description: Slice 5B1 structural payload only (keys/types/closed enums/additionalProperties). Semantic rules — Asia/Tokyo canonicalize for progress_at, reject bad/naive/fractional timestamps, and true-integer (not bool/string/float) effort fields — are enforced by normalize_task_progress_effect, not by this schema alone. Explicit post-state remaining/status only; no inferred progress from duration.

progress_at.description: Structural: non-empty string. Semantic canonicalize to Asia/Tokyo +09:00 is owned by normalize_task_progress_effect.

effort_spent_min.description: True integer minutes spent (>=1). Bool/float/string rejected by semantic normalizer.

effort_remaining_after_min.description: True integer remaining after progress (>=0). Bool/float/string rejected by semantic normalizer.

oneOf.description: Strict TASK_PROGRESS (Slice 5B1). Structural schema + semantic normalizer; Schedule reducer only; Foundation apply_effect raises UNSUPPORTED_EFFECT.

payload.description: Slice 5B2C2B structural payload only (keys/types/additionalProperties). Semantic rules — Asia/Tokyo canonicalize for completed_at, reject bad/naive/fractional timestamps — are enforced by normalize_commitment_complete_effect, not by this schema alone. PLANNED→COMPLETED only via complete_commitment; no MISSED/CANCELLED/DEFERRED.

completed_at.description: Structural: non-empty string. Semantic canonicalize to Asia/Tokyo +09:00 is owned by normalize_commitment_complete_effect.

oneOf.description: Strict COMMITMENT_COMPLETE (Slice 5B2C2B). Structural schema + semantic normalizer; Schedule reducer / runtime dispatcher only; Foundation apply_effect raises UNSUPPORTED_EFFECT.
